incidents.summary: Pearl's July 1 MoE (mixture-of-experts) PoW extension had an economic-pricing bug: sparse expert-routed proofs were credited as full dense-difficulty work, letting miners claim outsized rewards without proportional real compute (not proof forgery, no PearlBridge custody impact, and DeFiLlama's hack database lists nothing for Pearl). Reported network hashrate rose from ~30 EH/s to 90+ EH/s over three weeks as this was exploited. The core team activated a dense-only PoW fork at mainnet height ~91,630 to shut off MoE crediting, with a same-day hotfix for a template-classification bug in the fork logic itself. Current chain height (91,737) is past the fork — the fix is live.

MinePRL, the canonical community pool tracked by this dashboard, is offline (site redirects visitors to prlscan.com); exact offline date within the past ~6 weeks is unconfirmed. Network hashrate and pool worker-count fields are null this snapshot pending a replacement public data source.
